title: A COMPLAINT ABOUT A SMALL PORTION

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The people of Joseph said to Joshua, "Why have you given us only one allotment and one portion for an inheritance? We are a numerous people, and the Lord has blessed us abundantly." "If you are so numerous," Joshua answered, "and if the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaites." - Josh 17:14-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The Joseph tribes come to Joshua with a complaint: their portion is too small for such a numerous people. There is a certain irony here. They claim the Lord has blessed them abundantly, yet they grumble that they have not been given enough. They want a larger inheritance handed to them without the work of clearing and claiming it.

Joshua's answer is wise and bracing. If you are truly so numerous and strong, he says, then go up, clear the forest, and make room for yourselves. In other words: you have more capacity than you are using. Do not merely complain about your portion; go and lay hold of what is available to you. The land was there; they simply had to do the hard work of clearing it.

There is a lesson here for us. Sometimes we grumble about our limitations while leaving untapped the very capacity God has given us. We ask for more while neglecting to use what we already have. God has often provided more room to grow than we have been willing to work for. Rather than complaining that our portion is too small, the invitation is to rise up, put our God-given strength to work, and take hold of what He has made available. Faith is not passive grumbling; it is active trust that gets to work (Jas 2:17).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you sometimes complain about your limits while leaving your capacity unused?
- What "forest" might God be calling you to clear rather than grumble about?
- How can you put your God-given strength to work instead of waiting to be handed more?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, forgive me when I grumble about my portion while neglecting the strength You have given me. Help me to rise up, do the hard work, and lay hold of what You have made available. Amen.
